description: Retrieves prediction market Alpha Gaps comparing Tresslers Group Bayesian model odds against Polymarket order books, along with Brier scores, calibration alpha (+3,480 bps benchmark), and cryptographic SHA-256 pre-commitments.

category.description: Optional filter by strategic intelligence domain.

limit.description: Maximum number of Alpha Gap records to return.

min_divergence.description: Minimum absolute divergence gap in percentage points (e.g. 20 for >= 20% gap).

status.description: Filter by status or settlement type (e.g., 'CONTRACT_SETTLED', 'OUTCOME_TRACKED', 'RESOLVED', 'PENDING', 'ALL').

name: get_alpha_gap

text.description: JSON representation of prediction market alpha gaps, model odds, Polymarket odds, and Brier calibration scores.
